meta.title: Kanlo – Kanban for teams
meta.description: Kanlo is a fast, focused Kanban platform. Start in the cloud in minutes, or run it on your own servers.

hero.eyebrow: Kanban · Cloud & self-hosted · Built in Rust
hero.intro: A fast, focused Kanban platform. Start in the cloud in minutes, or run it on your own servers.

features.title: Everything a team needs. Nothing it doesn’t.

boards.title: Boards that flex
boards.text: Projects, boards and columns with cards, labels, due dates and assignees.

permissions.title: Granular permissions
permissions.text: Roles for owners, admins and members, plus per-member overrides and shared label and assignee groups.

github.title: GitHub mirror boards
github.text: See your GitHub issues on a read-only board, right next to your own work.

plugins.title: Plugins & templates
plugins.text: Extend Kanlo with WASM plugins and templates from the marketplace.

rust.title: Built in Rust
rust.text: One lean binary for API, web app and admin. Fast to run, simple to operate.

calendar.title: Calendar feeds
calendar.text: Subscribe to due dates in your calendar with a read-only ICS feed.

deploy.cloudText: Hosted on European servers and always up to date. No setup, no maintenance.
deploy.enterpriseText: Self-host it on your own servers or get a dedicated server. Includes Microsoft sign-in.

team.includes: Boards, projects and cards · Labels and assignees · [TEAM FEATURES]

enterprise.includes: Everything in Business · Microsoft sign-in · Self-hosted or dedicated · Audit log

cta.title: Ready to move your work forward?
